#define j0 _j0
#define j1 _j1
#define jn _jn
#define y0 _y0
#define y1 _y1
#define yn _yn
#define gamma _gamma
#define lgamma _lgamma
#define tgamma _tgamma
#include <stddef.h>
#if defined(__APPLE__)
#include <OpenGL/gl.h>

#endif

#undef y1

#undef lgamma
#undef tgamma

#ifndef M_PI

#endif

static float g_angle = 0.0f;
static int   g_rotating = 0;

--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
  float A[8], B[8], C[8];
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -19.0000f);
  glRotatef(30.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
  glRotatef(0.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -0.0000f, -0.0000f);
--- header_post ---
--- source ---
  static float th, px, py, pz; // shared orbit scratch: angle + world position

  OrbitRings(rad, tilt) {
    glBegin(GL_LINE_LOOP);
      for(i, 0, 96) {
        glVertex3f(cos(i*TAU/96)*rad, sin(i*TAU/96)*rad*sin(tilt), sin(i*TAU/96)*rad*cos(tilt));
      }
    glEnd();
  }
  // planet(): one lit sphere on an inclined circular orbit. th/px/py/pz
  // stay set after the call so the caller can hang a label off the body.
  planet(orbitR, rate, phase, incl, prad, cr, cg, cb) {
    th = t*rate + phase;
    px = cos(th)*orbitR;
    py = sin(th)*orbitR*sin(incl);
    pz = sin(th)*orbitR*cos(incl);
    glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
    glColor3f(cr, cg, cb);
    glPushMatrix();
      glTranslatef(px, py, pz);
      glutSolidSphere(prad, 24, 18);
    glPopMatrix();
    glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  }
  glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SPECULAR, (GLfloat[]){0.35, 0.33, 0.3, 1});
  glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SHININESS, (GLfloat[]){18});
  glClearColor(0.02, 0.02, 0.05, 1);
  glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE);
  // use cull face since we are using blending we want the effect to be view independent
  glEnable(GL_CULL_FACE);

  // the sun: drawn unlit so it glows (it sits on the SOLAR light at origin)
  glEnable(GL_BLEND);
  glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE);
  glDisable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  // soft corona, then two pulsing shells at different frequencies
  glColor4f(1, 0.72, 0.22, 0.16);
  glutSolidSphere(0.72 + sin(t*1.3)*0.02, 24, 24);
  glColor4f(1, 0.85, 0.3, 0.5);
  glutSolidSphere(0.56 + cos(2*t)*0.012, 24, 24);
  glutSolidSphere(0.5 + sin(t)*0.012, 24, 24);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glutSolidSphere(0.45, 24, 24);
  glColor3f(1, 0.9, 0.5);
  glRasterPos3f(0.62, 0.58, 0);
  label("Sun");

  // planets: lit by the central SOLAR light; glColor rides GL_COLOR_MATERIAL
  // and one shared specular material gives every body a sun-glint
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT0);
  glEnable(GL_COLOR_MATERIAL);
  // Mercury (0.38 Earth radii)
  planet(1.4, 1.6, 0.0, 0.18, 0.105, 0.63, 0.58, 0.54);
  glColor3f(0.9, 0.85, 0.8);
  glRasterPos3f(px + 0.14, py + 0.16, pz);
  label("Mercury");
  // Venus (0.95 Earth radii)
  planet(2.05, 1.15, 1.0, 0.06, 0.165, 0.93, 0.81, 0.55);
  glColor3f(1, 0.9, 0.65);
  glRasterPos3f(px + 0.2, py + 0.22, pz);
  label("Venus");
  // Earth (the reference radius) + Moon circling it
  planet(2.7, 0.85, 2.5, 0.0, 0.17, 0.3, 0.52, 0.95);
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(px, py, pz);
    glRotatef(t*160, 0, 1, 0);
    glTranslatef(0.34, 0.03, 0);
    glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
    glColor3f(0.72, 0.72, 0.7);
    glutSolidSphere(0.046, 12, 10);
    glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glPopMatrix();
  glColor3f(0.6, 0.8, 1);
  glRasterPos3f(px + 0.2, py + 0.22, pz);
  label("Earth");
  // Mars (0.53 Earth radii)
  planet(3.35, 0.62, 4.0, 0.22, 0.125, 0.88, 0.45, 0.26);
  glColor3f(1, 0.6, 0.45);
  glRasterPos3f(px + 0.16, py + 0.18, pz);
  label("Mars");
  // Jupiter (11.2 Earth radii before compression)
  planet(4.5, 0.36, 1.8, 0.05, 0.57, 0.83, 0.69, 0.52);
  glColor3f(1, 0.85, 0.65);
  glRasterPos3f(px + 0.62, py + 0.5, pz);
  label("Jupiter");
  // Saturn (9.4 Earth radii) + two ring bands with a Cassini gap.
  // Rings are flat strips, so culling is off while they draw - either
  // face may point at the camera.
  planet(5.8, 0.26, 3.4, 0.10, 0.52, 0.9, 0.8, 0.58);
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(px, py, pz);
    glRotatef(27, 1, 0, 0.35);
    glDisable(GL_CULL_FACE);
    glBegin(GL_TRIANGLE_STRIP);
      for(s, 0, 33) {
        glColor4f(0.85, 0.75, 0.55, 0.5);
        glVertex3f(cos(s*TAU/32)*0.66, 0, sin(s*TAU/32)*0.66);
        glColor4f(0.9, 0.82, 0.6, 0.3);
        glVertex3f(cos(s*TAU/32)*0.88, 0, sin(s*TAU/32)*0.88);
      }
    glEnd();
    glBegin(GL_TRIANGLE_STRIP);
      for(s, 0, 33) {
        glColor4f(0.8, 0.72, 0.5, 0.35);
        glVertex3f(cos(s*TAU/32)*0.93, 0, sin(s*TAU/32)*0.93);
        glColor4f(0.75, 0.68, 0.48, 0.12);
        glVertex3f(cos(s*TAU/32)*1.05, 0, sin(s*TAU/32)*1.05);
      }
    glEnd();
    glEnable(GL_CULL_FACE);
  glPopMatrix();
  glColor3f(1, 0.9, 0.7);
  glRasterPos3f(px + 1.1, py + 0.4, pz);
  label("Saturn");
  // Uranus (4.0 Earth radii) + a thin ring standing nearly on end:
  // the planet is tipped ~98 degrees, so its rings face the sun pole-on
  planet(6.8, 0.18, 5.2, 0.07, 0.34, 0.58, 0.82, 0.88);
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(px, py, pz);
    glRotatef(98, 0, 0, 1);
    glDisable(GL_CULL_FACE);
    glBegin(GL_TRIANGLE_STRIP);
      for(s, 0, 33) {
        glColor4f(0.72, 0.88, 0.92, 0.4);
        glVertex3f(cos(s*TAU/32)*0.44, 0, sin(s*TAU/32)*0.44);
        glColor4f(0.72, 0.88, 0.92, 0.1);
        glVertex3f(cos(s*TAU/32)*0.58, 0, sin(s*TAU/32)*0.58);
      }
    glEnd();
    glEnable(GL_CULL_FACE);
  glPopMatrix();
  glColor3f(0.75, 0.92, 0.95);
  glRasterPos3f(px + 0.6, py + 0.35, pz);
  label("Uranus");
  // Neptune (3.9 Earth radii)
  planet(7.7, 0.13, 0.7, 0.14, 0.335, 0.28, 0.42, 0.9);
  glColor3f(0.55, 0.65, 1);
  glRasterPos3f(px + 0.42, py + 0.34, pz);
  label("Neptune");
  // live readout: Earth's orbital phase, anchored in 3D below the system
  glColor3f(0.75, 0.8, 0.9);
  glRasterPos3f(-2.6, -5.6, 0);
  label("Earth phase = %f", fmod(t*0.85 + 2.5, TAU));

  // faint orbit rings (unlit lines), one per planet at its inclination
  glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glColor3f(0.22, 0.24, 0.34);
  glLineWidth(1.2);
  OrbitRings(1.4, 0.18);
  OrbitRings(2.05, 0.06);
  OrbitRings(2.7, 0.0);
  OrbitRings(3.35, 0.22);
  OrbitRings(4.5, 0.05);
  OrbitRings(5.8, 0.10);
  OrbitRings(6.8, 0.07);
  OrbitRings(7.7, 0.14);
